cheese pastry noun

also layered cheese pastry, cheese-filled pastry

classical

Cato, Agr. 76
Hor. Ep. I 10, 11

placenta, placentae f.

noun, first declension

a layered cake of dough sheets and cheese

Catō’s layered cake of dough sheets (tracta) and cheese, built sheet by sheet (Agr. 76; Hor. Ep. I 10, 11): the nearest ancient thing to a layered cheese pastry. placenta is attested and genuinely layered, so it carries the idea of a layered cheese pastry honestly; the Romanian plăcintă family continues the Latin word.

Examples

  • Māne placentam calidam ēmimus.

    In the morning we bought a warm cheese pastry.composed

  • placenta cāseō farta

    a cheese-filled pastrycomposed

See also white cheese, cheese.
